note: The series is made by data/seed-examples.mjs with its first period a week or more before the seed ran. Its page shows no Missing row (a series with no issue shows 'No issues yet'), so the dialog is opened with 'New issue', which proposes the first missing period, the same dialog the Missing row's Create opens. The proposal follows the backend's clock, not the specs' fixed clock: taken on 2026-11-12, after the seed of that day, it is week 46; a run a week later proposes the same week 46 (the first missing one) until the seed is run again, which moves the first period on. The series' criteria are those of the weekly NtM, and the copy has no NM notice published in November, hence 0 messages.
